name: 𝐋𝐀𝐊𝐒𝐇𝐀𝐍 𝐗 𝐌𝐃
description: 𝐋𝐀𝐊𝐒𝐇𝐀𝐍 𝐗 𝐌𝐃 - Ultra fast modern multi-device WhatsApp bot with 338+ commands, GitHub/MongoDB storage and a neon-purple web pairing dashboard. Powerd by Lakshan X MD.

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection string. Set this as a private Heroku config variable.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub Personal Access Token with 'repo' scope. This is where all bot data is stored.

GITHUB_BRANCH.description: Branch to commit data to. Leave blank for the repo default.

GITHUB_DB_DIR.description: Folder inside the repo for the JSON files.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Groq API key that powers the .support AI assistant. Get one free at console.groq.com. Leave blank to disable AI support (.support still returns raw diagnostics).

GROQ_MODEL.description: Optional Groq model override. Leave blank to auto-select a working model (Groq retires models regularly).

WA_VERSION.description: Optional WhatsApp Web build override, e.g. 2.3000.1042466098. Leave blank for automatic detection. Only set this if device linking breaks.

OWNER_NUMBERS.description: Owner numbers separated by commas, with country code and no plus sign.

CHANNEL_JID.description: Newsletter JID for auto follow and branding.

AUTO_FOLLOW_CHANNEL.description: Auto follow the support channel on connect.
